content:
dana: Quick sync — from the postmortem of the /api-serving outage: can owners confirm action items + due dates? Need owners by EOD PST. cc @ben @cheng @alexa

```
1) Add retry + exponential backoff in routing service — owner: ? — due: 2026-03-24
2) Add synthetic load test to CI (exercise routing+cache) — owner: ? — due: 2026-03-31
3) Update runbook with fallback policy and verify steps — owner: ? — due: 2026-03-22
4) Postmortem doc: final review and publish — owner: ? — due: 2026-03-20
```

ben: I`ll take 1) routing retry/backoff. ETA 2026-03-24. Will open PR today and link it to the tracker.

cheng: I`ll pick 2) synthetic load test. Planning to add a nightly job (BUILD-123) and a small harness. Target 2026-03-31.

alexa: I`ll do 3) runbook update + verification run. Small doc + one run through with oncall. Due 2026-03-22.

sam: I can do 4) final review of the postmortem. Will finish by EOD 2026-03-20 and publish.

dana: Thanks — can each of you add the action item in the incident tracker with tag `postmortem-1768` and post the issue link here? We need explicit owners for follow-ups.

ben: Done: https://tracker/redwood/issue/INF-487 (owner=ben, due=2026-03-24). Added checklist + PR placeholder.

cheng: Created INF-488 (owner=cheng, due=2026-03-31). CI job will be `nightly-synth-load` in infra/tests repo.

alexa: INF-489 created (owner=alexa, due=2026-03-22). I`ll also add a short run to the eng-oncall playbook.

sam: INF-490 (owner=sam, due=2026-03-20). Left a comment asking docs for editorial pass.

incident-bot: Automated reminder: actions with due <= 2026-03-22 — 2 open. Will ping owners 48h before due.

dana: One more ask: if any owner needs cross-team help (infra, docs, security), reply with which team and what exact help so we can mark dependencies.

cheng: Need eng-infra: please increase test cluster GPU quota by 2 for the nightly; will run at 2am UTC and need access to 2x A100 equivalent for 3 hours. @eng-infra

eng-infra: eng-infra: we can approve quota. Please file an infra request with expected window + resource spec (vm type, disk). We`ll aim to approve within 24h.

alexa: Also tagging @docs for a quick review of runbook phrasing before publish.

lina: lina (docs): happy to review. Can you drop the runbook draft in a PR or gdoc and ping me? I`ll review within one business day.

dana: :thumbsup: Great. I`ll follow up in the tracker tomorrow to confirm progress and close any gaps. Thanks everyone.
